limitations: This is feasibility evidence only, not a G1 PASS or G4 p95 hardware qualification.

The v0 setup is development-only and does not establish ceremony or production provenance.
Generated binaries and proofs remain outside Git; this record contains their identities, hashes, and measured summaries only.
No BCH transaction construction, admission, relay, broadcast, funding, mining, or mainnet activity occurred.
